basic_info.description: Situated in the Richmond District, a stone's throw away from Golden Gate Park, this elegant Edwardian integrates period details w/ contemporary amenities. MAIN: Living room w/ bright bay windows, wood-burning fireplace & built-ins; formal dining room, updated kitchen w/ backyard access, breakfast nook, & half bathroom. UPPER: Three bedrooms on one level. Master suite w/ walk-in closet & luxe bathroom w/ separate shower & soaking tub, two spacious bedrooms w/ peek-a-boo GG Bridge views, & full bathroom off the hallway, & built-in desk. LOWER: Internally accessible from the main level. Features laundry, fourth bedroom, full bathroom, backyard access, & 1 car parking in garage w/ additional storage and workbench. Quick walk to Geary & Clement.
